title: Enjoyable sailing trip! Nice way to see different perspective of Barcelona!
text: Beautiful sailing! Impressive handling of the boat by only one person - really nice guy. Enjoyed the sites of Barcelona from a different perspective while sipping Cava!
author: Susan_M

title: Unforgettable Experience
text:
Having been on quite a few sailing trips, this was easily the best. I got a chance to help sail the boat, hoisting the sails and take the helm. 
Unai the skipper was super friendly and professional. It was more like being with a friend. 
The open bar was cool, and even though there was no limit, nobody abused it. 
But the very best if all was being able to go for a swim out at sea. Amazing!
This was a completely different thing to do in the city and gave me a totally different view looking back at Barcelona. I’d definitely recommend it.
author: Rob_C
